test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following ports in NOT located in Asia?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rotterdam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rotterdam ports** in **NOT located in Asia.**
 
• **The Port of Rotterdam**, which is situated in and around the city of Rotterdam, in the Dutch province of South Holland, is the largest seaport in Europe and the largest seaport outside of East Asia.
 
• By annual cargo tonnage, it was the busiest port in the world from **1962 until 2004.**
 
• The port of Singapore overtook it first in 2004; since then, Shanghai and other sizable Chinese seaports have surpassed it.
 
• In terms of the volume of twenty-foot equivalent units (TEU) handled, Rotterdam was the tenth-largest container port in the world in 2020.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The main port in Japan is the Port of Osaka,** which is situated in Osaka within Osaka Bay. The Port of Busan is one of many sister ports of the Port of Osaka.
 
• A deep-sea port and a river port make up the **Port of Shanghai,** which is close to Shanghai. The Shanghai International Port Group, Shanghai's primary port corporation, was created when the Shanghai Port Authority was reorganised.
 
• The collective buildings and terminals that manage Singapore's harbours and shipping are referred to as the** Port of Singapore.**
